Numerical tests cover eight groups but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Near-extremal Fourier decay on a natural finite-field Kakeya set now implies q-uniform, dimension-free total-variation closeness to its balanced law. This addresses near-extremizer structure not determined by the classical graph spectral optimum or generic Kakeya Fourier existence theorems.
